**The Complete University Guide – 2024 (UK) Top 5 universities**  
| Rank | University | Year founded / established* |
|------|------------|------------------------------|
| 1 | University of Oxford | **c. 1096** – the earliest recorded teaching activity; the university’s formal charter dates from the 13th century. |
| 2 | University of Cambridge | **1209** – founded by scholars fleeing Oxford. |
| 3 | Imperial College London | **1907** – created by the merger of the Royal College of Science, the Royal School of Mines and the City & Guilds College. |
| 4 | London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE) | **1895** – founded by the Fabian Society members Sidney Webb and George Cecil Robinson. |
| 5 | University of St Andrews | **1413** – chartered by Pope Martin V; Scotland’s oldest university. |

\* “Year founded/established” refers to the date when the institution was originally created or received its charter. In a few cases (Oxford and Cambridge) the exact year is approximate because the universities evolved from earlier medieval schools.

---

### How the list was determined
The Complete University Guide publishes an annual league‑table of UK universities. The **2024 edition** ranks the institutions as shown above; the ranking is based on the Guide’s own composite metric (student satisfaction, entry standards, research quality, graduate prospects, etc.).  

If you need the full 2024 table or want to double‑check the ranking (for example, if a later update moved a university into or out of the top‑5), you can view the official list on the Guide’s website:

* **The Complete University Guide – 2024 UK University Rankings**  
  (URL: https://www.thecompleteuniversityguide.co.uk/league-tables/rankings)
